name: skill-ai
description: Personal skill marketplace for rizalvalry. Single plugin (skill-ai) containing 8 specialized skills with no-duplication boundaries and split-contract handoffs: project-manager (OWNER), planner, developer, solution-architect, bug-hunter, qa-analysis, ai-engineer, game-developer.

plugins.name: skill-ai
plugins.description: Eight specialized skills with explicit ownership and structured handoffs across delivery governance, planning, architecture, implementation, debugging, QA, AI engineering, and game development. `project-manager` is the OWNER layer: it aggregates every skill via an Ownership Ledger, routes work to the owning skill, enforces handoff contracts, and gates acceptance — without ever making decisions inside another skill's domain. Includes Opus-pinned `project-manager` and `planner` subagents and a Sonnet-pinned `developer` subagent.
